title: Injectivity of the parity tuple map
statement: For fixed natural numbers $n$ and $d$, the map sending a choice of six pairwise disjoint $d$-element subsets of an $n$-element set to the four incident supports indexed by the vertices of the complete graph on four vertices is injective.
